Subject: [PownceAPI] Redirect Url's


Since my applications exist outside of the Pownce website, when you  
send someone a link, and they view it through one of my applications,  
its pretty obvious the view count will not change.

I'd love to see some sort of url redirect link that we can pass url's  
to which will then increment the view count.

Let me know what you think.

Kyle Browning
